prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop website composition, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design the PGKhata marketing homepage as a refined operational ledger for Indian PG owners. Composition option A: a split first viewport with a compact floating navigation, a very large left-aligned promise and two actions on the left, and a dominant live rent-collection board on the right showing the four-step progression from tenant to itemized bill to WhatsApp delivery to paid status. Below the fold, reveal the start of a full-width ruled workflow section so the concept clearly governs the rest of the site.
Style/medium: production-grade web UI design comp, flat front-on screenshot, semantic interface rather than an illustration or device mockup
Composition/framing: desktop landscape, navigation at top; headline occupies roughly 42% width; collection board occupies roughly 52% width and is the deepest object; strong asymmetry, generous margins, clear primary CTA above the fold
Color palette: established PGKhata system only—warm paper #faf9f8, white #ffffff, ledger green #154212, hover green #2d5a27, ink #1a1c1c, muted gray-green #72796e, pale leaf #bcf0ae, semantic amber and red used sparingly for payment status
Materials/textures: matte paper-like fields, hairline rules, one soft downward ambient shadow under the product board; no decorative gradients, glow, glass, noise, or stock photos
Typography: characterful editorial serif for the main promise; clean compact grotesk sans for navigation, controls, numbers and rows; large but no larger than 80px
Text (verbatim): brand name PGKhata and headline Rent collection, without the chaos. only. Render all other copy as indistinct interface lines or compact unlabeled data marks; Indian rupee symbols and believable tabular amounts may appear as data.
Product proof: collection board should visibly contain tenant rows, room/bed references, itemized rupee amounts, a WhatsApp delivery cue, and Paid/Pending status pills; credible but clearly illustrative data
Responsive implication: structure must be able to stack cleanly on mobile
Constraints: no generic bento grid, no icon-card section, no smartphone frame, no laptop frame, no fake testimonial, no logos besides PGKhata, no invented customer claims, no browser chrome, no watermark
